run_config_update: run an async POST to /config/update to set litellm success callback to langfuse
run_chat_completion: run an async POST to /chat/completions with a model, messages, and optional metadata
test_team_logging: test that chat completion logs are sent to langfuse by verifying generations via trace id
review_config_update: review the config_update function that posts langfuse environment variables and callbacks to litellm
refactor_chat_completion: refactor the chat_completion function to support additional model parameters or metadata fields
